name: أزواج الذاكرة
tagline: اقلبوا البطاقات بالتناوب: اعثر على زوج والعب مجددًا.
description: العب أزواج الذاكرة مجانًا: لعبة أزواج البطاقات من 2 إلى 6 لاعبين بالتناوب مع الأصدقاء أو الروبوتات أو عبر الإنترنت، بـ 12 أو 20 أو 30 بطاقة.
about: Memory Pairs is the card game of pairs, played taking turns: Memory Match's cards for 2 to 6 players, with friends, bots, or online. The cards lie face down in pairs; turn two over, and if they match, they're yours and you go again.
A miss shows both cards for a moment and passes the turn, so everyone gets a look: the game is remembering where each symbol was. When the table is clear, the most pairs win; a tie is shared.
Choose 12, 20 or 30 cards. Online, the layout is kept on our server and each card is turned as it's chosen, so nobody can peek at the face-down cards. For a race against the clock, play Memory Match.
howToPlay: Choose 12, 20 or 30 cards, then Play vs bots, Play on this device, or create a room.
On your turn, tap a face-down card, then a second one.
A pair stays face up and scores, and you go again.
A miss shows both cards for a moment, then turns them back; the next player goes.
When every pair is found, the most pairs win.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a card to turn it.
Keyboard: Tab or the arrow keys move between cards; Enter or Space turns one.
tips: Watch the other players' turns: every card they turn is a free look for you.
Turn a card you've never seen first; if it matches one you remember, you know where to go.
Late in the game, a known pair is worth more than a guess.
Bots forget too: easy ones a lot, hard ones hardly at all.

faq.question: Is Memory Pairs free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: How is it different from Memory Match?
faq.answer: Memory Match is a race against the clock, alone or against others on the same layout. Memory Pairs is taking turns at one table, and the most pairs win.

faq.question: Can anyone see the face-down cards online?
faq.answer: No. The layout is kept on our server, and each card is turned only when it's chosen. The seed is revealed at the end, matching the fingerprint shown at the start.

faq.question: What happens on a tie?
faq.answer: Everyone with the most pairs shares the win.
